title: Three independent agents
art: abstract glowing network of connected nodes, dark blue background, digital art
caption: Each agent is an orchestrator of independent tasks on one small shared engine.
narration: Our system features three independent agents. Each acts as an orchestrator running its own tasks, where every single task is carefully traced and tested to ensure reliability.

title: Coding agent: local LLM
art: futuristic data center with flowing streams of light and documents, blue and teal
caption: Runs on a local open source model with Ollama. The critic can send it back for another round.
narration: The coding agent runs on a local open source model. It plans searches, researches the web, extracts facts, filters out public companies, ranks the rest and enriches missing data. A critic can send it back for another round before the final top ten report.
note: Last coding-agent run: 1 round(s), 8 tasks, 106 s

title: Image agent: team logo
art: artist studio with glowing holographic design sketches, purple and blue, digital art
caption: A local diffusion model draws the emblem, CLIP scores it, and the name is added with crisp text.
narration: Our image agent writes a brand brief, creates a prompt, draws an emblem with a local diffusion model, scores it, and refines it until it passes. Then it adds the team name.

title: Video agent: this video
art: film editing studio with glowing timeline screens, dark teal, cinematic digital art
caption: Local diffusion art, a local voice, and ffmpeg turn the plan into this video.
narration: Our video agent plans scenes, draws background art, checks quality, composes the diagram, records narration with a local voice, and assembles the clips with ffmpeg to create your final video.

title: Everything runs locally
art: single glowing laptop at night surrounded by floating light particles, digital art
caption: No cloud API is used by any agent.
narration: Everything runs smoothly on just one laptop. You get a local language model, a local image model, and local tools, all working together with absolutely no cloud services needed at all.
